PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarkers or pharmacodynamic markers reported to assess whether the intended enhanced anti-tumor immune response was achieved. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint (PFS) clearly failed with HR 0.95 (p=0.845), showing no benefit over control arm of nivolumab/ipilimumab alone. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Trial appears adequately powered (N=156) with appropriate duration (44 months). The failure appears to be mechanistic - the UV1 vaccine addition provided no benefit over standard checkpoint blockade.

HR 0.95 with p=0.845 shows no improvement over standard checkpoint blockade, suggesting the telomerase vaccination strategy did not enhance the immune response as intended.
